CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.app_has_permission(requested text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.app_users au
    where au.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and au.active
      and (au.role = 'admin' or requested = any(au.permissions))
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.app_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.app_users au
    where au.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and au.active and au.role = 'admin'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.app_workspace_owner_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select private.app_workspace_id()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shopify_analytics_owner()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v uuid:=private.app_workspace_owner_id(); begin
 if auth.uid() is null or v is null or not private.app_has_permission('shopify') then raise exception 'No tienes permiso de Shopify.' using errcode='42501';end if;return v;end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.amazon_analytics_timezone()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select z.name from public.app_settings s join pg_catalog.pg_timezone_names z
    on z.name=s.config->'general'->>'timezone' where s.owner_id=private.app_workspace_owner_id() limit 1),'Europe/Madrid')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.amazon_mapping_cost_snapshot(p_owner uuid, p_account uuid, p_seller_sku text, p_event_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(mapping_count bigint, unit_cost_eur numeric, missing_historical_count bigint, missing_fx_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER ROWS 1
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    count(m.id)::bigint as mapping_count,
    coalesce(sum(
      case
        when h.normalized_unit_price is not null and fx.rate_to_eur is not null
          then m.consumption_factor*h.normalized_unit_price*fx.rate_to_eur
        else 0
      end
    ),0)::numeric as unit_cost_eur,
    count(*) filter (
      where m.id is not null and h.normalized_unit_price is null
    )::bigint as missing_historical_count,
    count(*) filter (
      where m.id is not null
        and h.normalized_unit_price is not null
        and fx.rate_to_eur is null
    )::bigint as missing_fx_count
  from public.amazon_product_mappings m
  left join lateral (
    select ph.normalized_unit_price,ph.currency,ph.price_date
    from public.product_price_history ph
    where ph.owner_id=p_owner
      and ph.product_id=m.product_id
      and ph.normalized_unit_price is not null
      and ph.price_date<=p_event_date
    order by ph.price_date desc,ph.created_at desc,ph.id desc
    limit 1
  ) h on true
  left join lateral (
    select private.amazon_rate_to_eur(h.currency,h.price_date) as rate_to_eur
  ) fx on true
  where m.owner_id=p_owner
    and m.amazon_account_id=p_account
    and m.seller_sku=p_seller_sku;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.amazon_setting_text(p_owner uuid, p_key text, p_fallback text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    nullif(trim((
      select s.config->'amazon'->>p_key
      from public.app_settings s
      where s.owner_id=p_owner
      limit 1
    )),''),
    p_fallback
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shopify_cost(owner uuid, store uuid, sku text, event_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(cost numeric, missing bigint, mapping_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select sum(h.normalized_unit_price*m.consumption_factor*private.amazon_rate_to_eur(h.currency,event_date)),count(*) filter(where h.id is null or private.amazon_rate_to_eur(h.currency,event_date) is null),count(*)
 from public.shopify_product_mappings m
 left join lateral(select ph.* from public.product_price_history ph where ph.owner_id=m.owner_id and ph.product_id=m.product_id and ph.price_date<=event_date order by ph.price_date desc,ph.created_at desc limit 1) h on true
 where m.owner_id=owner and m.integration_account_id=store and m.seller_sku=sku and owner=private.shopify_analytics_owner();$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shopify_shipping(owner uuid, store uuid, remote_order text, event_date date)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select f.shipping_cost_net_amount*private.amazon_rate_to_eur(coalesce(nullif(f.shipping_cost_currency,''),'EUR'),coalesce((f.shipping_cost_recorded_at at time zone private.amazon_analytics_timezone())::date,event_date))
 from public.fulfillment_orders f where f.owner_id=owner and owner=private.shopify_analytics_owner() and f.source_channel='shopify'
 and f.source_integration_account_id=store and (f.order_id=remote_order or f.sendcloud_id='shopify:'||store::text||':'||remote_order)
 order by f.shipping_cost_recorded_at desc nulls last,f.last_synced_at desc nulls last limit 1;$function$
